summary: South Africa does not permit dual citizenship except in specific circumstances. Citizens who acquire foreign nationality without prior permission lose their South African citizenship automatically.

citizenship.dualCitizenshipNote: South Africa's Citizenship Act (Act 88 of 1995) generally prohibits dual citizenship. South African citizens who voluntarily acquire foreign citizenship lose their SA citizenship unless they applied for and received prior permission from the Minister of Home Affairs to retain it.

diasporaProgram.name: No dedicated diaspora program
diasporaProgram.statusNote: South Africa does not have a diaspora citizenship or right-of-return program. South Africans who emigrated and took foreign citizenship typically lost their SA citizenship. Re-acquisition is possible but requires a formal process through DHA.
diasporaProgram.eligibility: South Africans by birth or descent. Those who lost citizenship by acquiring foreign nationality may apply to re-acquire it through DHA.
diasporaProgram.applicationFeeNote: Contact DHA (Department of Home Affairs) for current fees.
keyDocuments: Previous South African passport or ID
Renunciation of foreign citizenship (may be required)
processSteps: Contact DHA (Department of Home Affairs) or SA Embassy
Determine citizenship status (whether it was lost or retained)
Apply for re-acquisition of citizenship if applicable
Consider permanent residency as an alternative pathway
diasporaProgram.verificationNote: Based on South African Citizenship Act 88 of 1995. South Africa's dual citizenship rules are strict and commonly misunderstood. Legal advice recommended.

keyFacts: SA citizens who took foreign nationality without DHA permission lose SA citizenship
Re-acquisition of citizenship is possible through DHA process
South Africa offers permanent residency as an alternative
Many SA diaspora have unknowingly lost their citizenship
whyItMatters: South Africa's strict dual citizenship laws have caused significant confusion in the diaspora. Many South Africans who emigrated to the UK, US, or Australia and later naturalized there have unknowingly lost their SA citizenship. Understanding your status before planning a return is essential.
